goal: Build a polished, Apple-inspired Sora forum homepage in the existing Vue Control Plane with mock data and working prototype interactions.
completed: Added the Sora forum homepage with a responsive desktop three-column layout, tablet two-column layout, and mobile collapsible rails.
Added fixed/compact glass Header with search, navigation, login, and persisted demo user menu.
Added category filtering, personal saved/following views, search suggestions and recent searches, article preview drawer, login modal, bookmark and follow actions.
Added accessibility labels, keyboard focus states, Escape handling, reduced-motion support, and responsive styling.
Updated the homepage E2E coverage for discovery, search, sign-in, and mobile rail behavior.
decisions: The existing apps/control-plane Vue entry remains the host, while /tasks and /evaluation routes are preserved.
Sora uses Traditional Chinese editorial content with a restrained Apple-inspired visual language and no external image dependency.
Authentication and content state are demo-only and persisted to localStorage as agreed for the prototype.
risks: The forum is a front-end prototype; production API, account security, and server persistence are not implemented.
